ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation Dream Job' signed-loader sideload from user-space drop path with immediate C2 egress
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Lazarus DLL-sideloading chain: a signed legitimate-vendor binary (often a trojanised TightVNC/PuTTY/Sumatra installer or a copy of a Microsoft/Adobe-signed app) executes from a non-system staging directory (\Users\Public, \ProgramData\IBM, \ProgramData\Adobe\ARM, \AppData\Local\Temp, \AppData\Roaming, \Downloads, \Desktop) and reaches out to a public IP within 60 seconds — the post-sideload beacon. This is the loader half of the Dream Job / ZINC / Diamond Sleet (Microsoft) / Labyrinth Chollima (CrowdStrike) intrusion chain documented by Mandiant, ESET, Microsoft and AhnLab
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as proc_time values(Processes.process_path) as loader_path values(Processes.process_hash) as loader_hash values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.process_name) as loader_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\IBM\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\Adobe\\ARM\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Desktop\\*") Processes.process_path!="*\\Windows\\*" Processes.process_path!="*\\Program Files\\*" Processes.user!="*$" by host Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval pid_key=host."_".process_id | join type=inner pid_key [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as net_time values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as remote_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as remote_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | eval pid_key=src."_".process_id] | eval delta=net_time-proc_time | where delta>=0 AND delta<=60 | table proc_time net_time host user loader_name loader_path loader_hash remote_ip remote_port
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let StageDirs = dynamic([@"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\IBM\", @"\ProgramData\Adobe\ARM\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Desktop\"]);
let SignedFromUserSpace =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has_any ("Microsoft","Adobe","VMware","Citrix","TightVNC","Sumatra","Symantec","Trend Micro","Igor Pavlov","TeamViewer","Google","PuTTY")
    | where FolderPath has_any (StageDirs)
    | where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\")
    | where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Program Files\")
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              LoaderName = FileName, LoaderPath = FolderPath, LoaderHash = SHA256,
              LoaderSigner = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
              LoaderProduct = ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
              LoaderPid = ProcessId;
SignedFromUserSpace
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionAttempt")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl,
              InitiatingProcessId
  ) on DeviceId, $left.LoaderPid == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + 60s)
| project SpawnTime, NetTime, DeviceName, AccountName, LoaderName, LoaderPath,
          LoaderSigner, LoaderProduct, LoaderHash, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let StageRegex = @"(?i)\\(Users\\Public|ProgramData\\IBM|ProgramData\\Adobe\\ARM|AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|Downloads|Desktop)\\";
let SignedFromUserSpace =
    ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where ActingProcessFileCompany has_any ("Microsoft","Adobe","VMware","Citrix","TightVNC","Sumatra","Symantec","Trend Micro","Igor Pavlov","TeamViewer","Google","PuTTY")
    | where TargetProcessName matches regex StageRegex
    | where not(TargetProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(Windows|Program Files)\\")
    | project SpawnTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              LoaderPath = TargetProcessName, LoaderHash = SHA256,
              LoaderSigner = ActingProcessFileCompany,
              LoaderPid = TargetProcessId;
SignedFromUserSpace
| join kind=inner (
    ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr) == false
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Url, ActingProcessId
  ) on DvcHostname, $left.LoaderPid == $right.ActingProcessId
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + 60s)
| project SpawnTime, NetTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, LoaderPath, LoaderSigner,
          LoaderHash, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Url
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus Operation Dream Job - Signed Vendor Binary Executing From User-Space Stage Directory
id: 8b2f4c1d-7e95-4a3a-91bd-2c5a2bda7f01
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of a signed legitimate-vendor binary (Microsoft, Adobe, VMware, TightVNC, Sumatra, PuTTY, etc.) from a non-system path commonly used by Lazarus Group (Dream Job / Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima) as a DLL-sideload staging directory.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/operation-dream-job
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2023/09/29/lazarus-luring-employees-trojanized-coding-challenges-case-spanish-aerospace-company/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_signed:
    Company|contains:
      - 'Microsoft'
      - 'Adobe'
      - 'VMware'
      - 'Citrix'
      - 'TightVNC'
      - 'Sumatra'
      - 'Symantec'
      - 'Trend Micro'
      - 'Igor Pavlov'
      - 'TeamViewer'
      - 'Google'
      - 'PuTTY'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\IBM\'
      - '\ProgramData\Adobe\ARM\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Desktop\'
  filter_system_paths:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\'
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_signed and selection_path and not 1 of filter_*
falsepositives:
  - Portable signed apps legitimately staged in user directories (squirrel/electron updaters, browser-managed installers)
  - Software distribution tools that stage signed installers in ProgramData prior to elevation
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\users\\public\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\IBM\\* OR *\\programdata\\ibm\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\Adobe\\ARM\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\appdata\\local\\temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\downloads\\* OR *\\Desktop\\* OR *\\desktop\\*) -@Image:(*\\Windows\\* OR *\\windows\\* OR *\\Program?Files\\* OR *\\program?files\\*) -@User:*$ @Company:(Microsoft* OR microsoft* OR Adobe* OR VMware* OR Citrix* OR TightVNC* OR Sumatra* OR Symantec* OR "Trend Micro"* OR "Igor Pavlov"* OR TeamViewer* OR Google* OR Simon?Tatham*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(Users\\Public|ProgramData\\IBM|ProgramData\\Adobe\\ARM|AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|Downloads|Desktop)\\/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(Windows|Program Files)\\/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| LoaderPid := TargetProcessId
| LoaderImage := ImageFileName
| LoaderHash := SHA256HashData
| LoaderTime := @timestamp
| join({
    #event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4
    | NOT cidr("10.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4)
    | NOT cidr("172.16.0.0/12", field=RemoteAddressIP4)
    | NOT cidr("192.168.0.0/16", field=RemoteAddressIP4)
    | NOT cidr("127.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4)
    | ConnTime := @timestamp
  }, field=[aid, ContextProcessId], include=[ConnTime, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort])
| Delta := ConnTime - LoaderTime
| Delta >= 0
| Delta <= 60000
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, LoaderImage, LoaderHash, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Three behaviours stack to make this Lazarus-specific rather than generic LOLBin noise: (a) Lazarus has used the exact stage-directory set (\Users\Public, \ProgramData\IBM, \ProgramData\Adobe\ARM, \AppData\Roaming) across Operation Dream Job (Mandiant 2022), the Spanish aerospace LightlessCan intrusion (ESET 2023), the 3CX downstream activity (Microsoft 2023) and Diamond Sleet's open-source-utility

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus Dream Job ISO/IMG/VHD container detonation - script-host or rundll32 execution within 1h of archive landing in mail-staging path
ucs.description: Detects the lure-delivery half of Operation Dream Job: an ISO/IMG/VHD container lands in a mail-attachment staging directory (Outlook OLK, INetCache, Downloads, Desktop), and within an hour a Windows script host (wscript/cscript/mshta) or proxy-execution binary (rundll32/regsvr32) executes content from the mounted volume drive letter or a script/LNK extracted from the container. Lazarus pivoted to ISO/IMG containers in late 2022 specifically to bypass Mark-of-the-Web warnings on .docm/.xlsm attachments, and every public Dream Job II report from 2023 onward (ESET LightlessCan, Mandiant UNC2970,
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as drop_time values(Filesystem.file_name) as container_name values(Filesystem.file_path) as container_path values(Filesystem.user) as drop_user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.iso" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.img" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.vhd" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.vhdx") (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Desktop\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Outlook\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Olk\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\INetCache\\*") by host | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as exec_time values(Processes.process_name) as script_host values(Processes.process) as script_cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_name values(Processes.user) as exec_user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="wscript.exe" OR Processes.process_name="cscript.exe" OR Processes.process_name="mshta.exe" OR Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" OR Processes.process_name="regsvr32.exe") (Processes.process="*.js*" OR Processes.process="*.vbs*" OR Processes.process="*.wsf*" OR Processes.process="*.hta*" OR Processes.process="*.lnk*" OR Processes.process="*.dll*" OR Processes.process="*D:\\*" OR Processes.process="*E:\\*" OR Processes.process="*F:\\*" OR Processes.process="*G:\\*" OR Processes.process="*H:\\*") Processes.user!="*$" by host | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | eval delta=exec_time-drop_time | where delta>=0 AND delta<=3600 | table drop_time exec_time host drop_user container_name container_path script_host script_cmd parent_name
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ContainerDrops =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(iso|img|vhd|vhdx)$"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Desktop\",
            @"\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Outlook\",
            @"\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Olk\",
            @"\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\INetCache\")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DropUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ContainerName = FileName, ContainerPath = FolderPath;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(\.(js|vbs|wsf|jse|vbe|hta|lnk|dll)|[D-Z]:\\)"
   or FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
| join kind=inner ContainerDrops on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (DropTime .. DropTime + 1h)
| project DropTime, ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ContainerName, ContainerPath,
          ScriptHost = FileName, ScriptCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by ExecTime desc

#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\.(iso|img|vhd|vhdx)$/i
| TargetFileName=/\\(Downloads|Desktop|Outlook|Olk|INetCache)\\/i
